classification: Exploratory variance pilot only; no adoption/profit claim
metricUnits: chip delta /2 = bb/hand; multiply mean by100 for bb/100
primaryWeighting: equal seed, equal pool stratum, equal table size, equal rotation, equal within-match hand

designs.unpaired: one preassigned balanced rotation/cell/table per seed, independent arm seeds; variance sum of arm cluster means
designs.paired: same preassigned rotations, paired seed clusters; variance of cluster differences
designs.rotated: all rotations, paired seed clusters; variance of macro cluster differences

power.method: normal planning approximation; also one-sided95% variance upper bound under approximately normal independent cluster means

cost: Use separate measured raw-only and adjusted rates at chosen14 workers; conservative planning rates80% of relevant measured minimum; no worker-count extrapolation

samplingNIProposal.assumedEffectRule: If pilot adjusted macro mean is nonnegative, max(0,min(mean/2,nominal95% lower bound)); if negative, use mean. Planning assumption only, independent confirmation required.

futureABC: Scenario counts are variance/cost proxies, not final N for unimplemented policies. Size primary model-v1 superiority; secondary effects need coherent policy-specific pilot before any power guarantee. No default test sized at true+5.
